crossRefs.note: David answered, “Behold the spear, O king! Then let one of the young men come over and get it.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David answered, “Behold the spear, O king! Then let one of the young men come over and get it.
translations.bsb: “Here is the king’s spear,” David answered. “Let one of the young men come over and get it.
translations.kjv: And David answered and said, Behold the king's spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.
translations.asv: And David answered and said, Behold the spear, O king! let then one of the young men come over and fetch it.
